fusions.name: Timber Falls
fusions.desc: You topple your own trunk along a narrow line 6 tiles long, dealing 32 damage to everything under it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Knotted Mallet
fusions.desc: Pays 5% of your maximum health to swing a knot of your own wood, dealing 8 damage and leaving the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Driven Stakes
fusions.desc: Hammers a row of sharpened stakes 5 tiles long into the ground ahead of you, blocking enemies for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Driven Deep

riders.text: the grain packs tighter under every blow
and what it strikes stays flat

fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1.
